    Is Clankr affiliated with Clanker?

    No. Clankr is an independent token and community project built on top of the Clanker ecosystem on Base. It is not made by, endorsed by, or affiliated with the Clanker team — it just loves the sound the machine makes.

    When does $CLANKR launch?

    When it's ready to be fair: low starting market cap, a clean sellable contract, and the announcement made after the pool is live — never a countdown before it. The contract address will appear on this page at that moment.

    Is the radar live?

    Not yet — what you see is a preview feed with sample launches showing how signal strength will read. The live Base feed plugs in at launch, along with the Clank Board's first real season.

    Can I mint a .clankr name today?

    Real on-chain names need their own contract, so today you can reserve: check your name above and hold the spot in this session. Reservations get first claim when minting opens at launch.
